items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Why didn’t he get a tenor player like Stan Getz?

ctx.x: This was after you had left the band right?

Yeah. I exclaimed and I don’t remember ever hearing the reason for that, the justification for that. Why didn’t he get a tenor player like Stan Getz? The fact was that I was playing the arrangements I played when I was in the band and Bird was playing new arrangements and for whatever state his health was in he wasn’t terribly comfortable with Charlie Parker playing so I didn’t listen to him, usually. How do you like that? As Miles Davis kind of indicted when he was standing next to him, he couldn’t really hear…
Miles said that he wanted to quit every night.
